pr_title: Fix Batches Deletion and flaky tests
pr_body:
- This issue fixes #5263 by removing the batches from the date and time databases.
- It also introduces a new `enqueued_at` field in the batch object to quickly retrieve them in the `batches.enqueued_at` database
- Finally, it probably fixes all the flaky tests of the batches: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5256

issue_context.title: Removing a batch leaks some internal dates in the database
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When we remove a task, that can trigger the deletion of a batch.
When we remove this batch we remove a lot of metadata associated to the batch, but we don't remove the associated dates from the `enqueued_at`, `started_at` and `finished_at` databases.

**To Reproduce**
We can see it typically in this snapshot test: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/crates/index-scheduler/src/scheduler/snapshots/test.rs/task_deletion_deleteable/task_deletion_processed.snap

We deleted a task, the associated batch has been removed and only the batch with the uid `1` remains.
That's successfully reflected in the mapping, statuses and kinds, but in all the time we can still see mention of the batch with the ID `0`.

**NOTE**:
This doesn't cause a panic while retrieving batches!
So the issue is really minor for now but should still be fixed because otherwise we may end up filling a queue with useless data.

**Expected behavior**
The batches are successfully removed.

**Meilisearch version:**
v1.12.0
Since the introduction of the batches.

review_comments: We now have an enqueued at? I suppose it's an object with oldest and earliest? Can you add a test to check that, please?
